title: PersonaFactory: Stylistic User Prompt Augmentation with Synthetic Persona Bank
abstract: arXiv:2611.34785v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models increasingly replace real people in the AI development pipeline, as they are used to generate training dialogues at scale and to drive alignment and evaluation. However, out-of-the-box models produce monolingual and stylistically flat texts as synthetic user prompts, failing to replicate the real user-AI communication mechanics. We present PersonaFactory, an end-to-end pipeline that generates detailed user personas and uses them to augment existing user prompts from their point of view, producing a bank of over 740000 structured synthetic personas detailing their background and communication behaviors, and a corpus of roughly 1.24 million persona-styled synthetic conversations spanning 85 languages. We evaluate the effect of personal features on style adoption and intent preservation, using an LLM-judge and heuristic metrics to assess augmentation fidelity together with the downstream impact on assistant persona c

translated_title: PersonaFactory：基于合成人格库的风格化用户提示增强
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在AI开发流程中越来越多地取代真人，被用于大规模生成训练对话以及驱动对齐与评估。然而，开箱即用的模型所生成的合成用户提示往往语言单一、风格平淡，无法复现真实的用户-AI交流机制。我们提出了PersonaFactory，这是一个端到端的流程，它可以生成详细的用户人格画像，并从这些人格的视角对现有用户提示进行增强。该方法产出了一个包含超过74万个结构化合成人格的库，详细刻画了每个角色的背景与交流行为；同时生成了一个覆盖85种语言、约124万条人格风格化合成对话的语料库。我们评估了个人特征对风格采纳和意图保留的影响，使用LLM裁判和启发式指标来衡量增强的保真度，以及其对助手人格定制的下游影响。
tldr: 该论文提出PersonaFactory端到端流程，构建了超74万个刻画背景与交流行为的结构化合成人格库，并以85种语言生成约124万条人格风格化对话，解决了合成用户提示风格单一、无法模拟真实用户交流机制的问题。
en_tdlr: PersonaFactory is an end-to-end pipeline that builds a bank of over 740K structured synthetic personas and uses them to augment user prompts into roughly 1.24M persona-styled conversations across 85 languages, addressing the stylistic flatness of synthetic user prompts.
